physicalIntent: Eight subtly raised rounded-outline head caps above a near-flat lower plate. Rust, coating and plate body share the plate plane with restrained local photo detail. The lower support includes visible dark head-contact shadows; they do not become new raised rings. No RGB, head position, palette, source scale, layout or perimeter change.

parameterBasis.planes: .61 head / .54 plate with .57 edge floor gives subtle .07 nominal head lift; relative uncalibrated units, not measured displacement. Every head support sample must remain above plate/pigment samples.
parameterBasis.micro: .004 limits full photo detail span to <=.008; reduces initial0..1 cragging and prevents broad oxide or green patches from becoming architecture.
parameterBasis.bevel: Source head outline radii are listed individually below, before inclusive polygon raster edges. Sigma8 is roughly one third of these radii, spreading the shoulder substantially through each cap instead of leaving a near-flat plateau. Unchanged guard maximum4 at256reference gives8masterpixels at512. No support outside the eight existing heads is raised; all perimeter remains lower plate.

supportedPolicyLimit: Existing wrapped Gaussian cap rounding is not calibrated dome reconstruction. The wider shoulder is one source-specific convexity trial. Actual neutral opposed lights and scalar profiles must establish convex shape; preserve a HOLD if flat plateaus, rings or colour-driven hollows remain. No automatic second trial or geometry PASS.
revision: Root actual source review rejected v2 1.2-master-pixel shoulder as too narrow for convex heads. V3 changes only bevelPixels to4 (8masterpixel sigma), preserving exact v2 polygon supports and .61/.54/.57/.004 planes/detail. One chosen source-specific wider cap trial, not parameter search.
geometryBasis: Separate actual source silhouettes measured around all eight generated heads. Lower mask is their complement split into explicit trapezoids; it does not create heads from scratch, move them or sample another texture. Polygon raster edges are mixed head/contact/plate pixels and must be reported honestly.
nextAction: Root exact wider rounded-cap trial review; then one guarded existing CLI successor bound to genuine proof. Actual float and neutral convexity before tiers.
